## What it is

A local laser engraving and cutting shop for industrial and commercial batch
work — nameplates, labels, safety locks, equipment tags, and related marked
parts — plus custom engraving and cutting for wood, acrylic, leather, and
similar materials. Work is quoted to order rather than sold from a fixed
catalog price list.

## How quoting works

There is no published price list. To get a quote, email
info@forestcitylaser.com or use the quote form on the site with:

- Quantity (batch size / how many units)
- Material (what the part is made of)
- Reorder info when applicable (prior job details, part numbers, or past artwork)

Quotes are handled by email. Repeat / reorder work is a core workflow for
industrial and safety-marking customers.

## Capacity and hours

- Laser bed: 20×28 inches
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 (Eastern)

## Key pages (service URLs)

- [Home](https://forestcitylaser.com/): overview of batch and industrial laser engraving and cutting
- [Industrial laser engraving — London Ontario](https://forestcitylaser.com/industrial-laser-engraving-london-ontario/): batch industrial marking, engraved equipment tags, custom asset tags, serialized parts
- [Lamacoid labels, tags & plates — London Ontario](https://forestcitylaser.com/lamacoid-labels-london-ontario/): custom engraved lamacoid (lamicoid) labels, tags and plates; engraved electrical panel and breaker labels; 22 mm and 30 mm push-button legend plates; engraved plastic labels, tags and signs; engraved plastic valve tags; solar, fire alarm and cable tag lamacoids
- [Phenolic nameplates — London Ontario](https://forestcitylaser.com/phenolic-nameplates-london-ontario/): engraved phenolic nameplates, plastic and electrical equipment nameplates, machine ID and data plates
- [Safety lock engraving — London Ontario](https://forestcitylaser.com/safety-lock-engraving-london-ontario/): numbered lockout padlock sets, custom engraved padlocks, padlock ID and lockout tags
- [Quantity quotes & reorders — London Ontario](https://forestcitylaser.com/quantity-quotes-reorders-london-ontario/): what to send for batch quotes, serialization and reorders
- [Laser engraving — London Ontario](https://forestcitylaser.com/laser-engraving-london-ontario/): general and multi-piece laser engraving
- [Custom signage — London Ontario](https://forestcitylaser.com/custom-signage-london-ontario/): acrylic business signs, engraved plastic signs, sign systems

Guides:

- [What lamacoid labels and control panel tags are used for](https://forestcitylaser.com/blog/what-lamacoid-labels-and-control-panel-tags-are-used-for/): what lamacoid is made of, lamacoid vs phenolic vs acrylic, common sizes, thickness and colours, panel labelling, valve tags, lockout tags
